description: This source file 'URL.cpp' implements URL parsing, encoding, decoding, and base64 encoding/decoding functionalities within the WPEFramework namespace. It defines methods for URL manipulation, including parsing URL components like scheme, host, path, query, and ref, as well as utility functions for URL encoding/decoding and base64 operations.

classes.name: URL
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing and representing URLs, providing methods to parse URL strings into components and reconstruct URL strings.

methods.name: URL::Encode
methods.description: Encodes a string to URL-encoded format, replacing special characters with %hex representations.

methods.name: URL::Decode
methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded string back to its original form.

methods.name: URL::Base64Encode
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a Base64 string with optional padding.

methods.name: URL::Base64Decode
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 string into binary data, ignoring specified characters.

methods.name: URL::Parse
methods.description: Parses a URL string into its components: scheme, username, password, host, port, path, query, and reference.

methods.name: URL::ParseDomain
methods.description: Parses the domain part of a URL, extracting the hostname and port.

methods.name: URL::Text
methods.description: Constructs the full URL string from the URL components.
